sections.title: The letter emm
paragraphs: The letter (emm) /ɛm/ stands for one main sound. You hear it in (ma) /ˈmɒ/, which means today. This letter always makes just one sound.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Press your lips gently together to close your mouth. Turn on your voice and let the air flow out through your nose. Touch your throat to feel the buzz of your vocal cords.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: The letter (emm) /ɛm/ appears in all standard positions. In every word, you say the sound as in (alma) /ˈɒlmɒ/.

sections.title: Everyday sounds
paragraphs: This sound is identical to the ordinary sound in mother. You will not face any difficulty when you say it.
